change: entityProperty(entity, identifier): App Intents entity property reads as native WFPropertyVariableAggrandizement; NativeEntityProperties generated from ToolKit EntityProperties; Home Assistant Fire Event bindings; alarm sync example.

nativeForm.source: Shortcuts editor on the simulator: Find Conversation → Text with the Conversation GUID property; ZSHORTCUTACTIONS read read-only.
nativeForm.finding: PropertyName is the property identifier, not the localized title.

entityPropertyProbe.shortcut: TS-Entity-Properties (artifacts/entity-property-probe.ts), 129 actions, public signing, imported through Files
entityPropertyProbe.importComparison: All 129 imported actions equal the compiler output (test/fixtures/ios26-entity-properties-workflow.json).
entityPropertyProbe.resolution: Query actions without AppIntentDescriptor were created as WFLinkContentItemFilterAction from the identifier (BackgroundShortcutRunner log).
limitations: Contacts and Photos queries returned no entities on this simulator, also with an explicit AppIntentDescriptor, so string, enum and number properties were not observed with data.

The simulator has no Clock app (MobileTimer.app is a stub without a binary; MTGetAlarmsIntent is absent from its ToolKit database). Find Alarms and AlarmEntity properties, including repeatDays, were not executed.

fireEvent.reference: Fire event created in the simulator editor with the Home Assistant dev CI artifact (2026.10.2): test/fixtures/home-assistant-fire-event-workflow.json
fireEvent.eventData: Stored as plain text (JSON text), not a dictionary.
fireEvent.server: Not capturable: the app has no server login; Choose shows 'Couldn't communicate with a helper application'.
fireEvent.probe: TS-FireEvent-Probe (artifacts/fire-event-probe.ts), 75 actions; imported actions equal the compiler output (test/fixtures/ios26-fire-event-probe-workflow.json). Editor showed Server 'Home Assistant', Event name iphone_wekkers, Event data = Text variable.
fireEvent.execution: Not executed: the CI artifact crashes at launch (missing Sodium_1BC75F510A1237_PackageProduct.framework), and no server exists. Privacy prompts appeared before the HTTP request and before sharing with Home Assistant.
fireEvent.releaseBinding: api/apps/home-assistant-release-fire-event.json is inferred from the dev capture plus the phone-exported release SetBrightness descriptor; not confirmed by a release export.

deliverables.neverSentTo: Simulator probes sent no data to the real Home Assistant server; they used http://127.0.0.1:8765 (scripts/http-echo.py).

deviceVerification.device: physical iPhone 17 (English locale), Home Assistant app 2026.10.1
deviceVerification.observed: Home Assistant received event iphone_wekkers (origin REMOTE, user context of the app's account) with all 15 Clock alarms: hours, minutes and labels ('Alarm', 'Nap') matched the device.
deviceVerification.notYetObserved: Every alarm was disabled and non-repeating, so enabled=true and the repeatDays text format have not been observed on a device yet.
